section.title.description: Heading of the Language section; outside English it keeps the English word: "ভাষা · Language".

select.label.description: Label of the language select; outside English it keeps the English words.

option.system.description: Option of the language select. {name} is the language Windows would give.

option.named.description: Option for a shipped language: its own name, then its name in the UI language: "বাংলা (Bangla)".

option.preview.description: Option for a language shown as a preview: "বাংলা (প্রিভিউ) · Bangla (preview)".

digits.label.description: Label of the digits radio group.

digits.western.description: Radio for Western digits; the digits are shown as they are.

restart.notice.description: Notice after a change. {name} is the chosen language.

restart.button.description: Restarts Flown to switch the language.

note.preview.description: Note while the language is a preview.

command.title.description: Command palette entry that opens Settings › Language.

command.keywords.description: Search words of the Language… command, comma separated; keep the language names.

offer.region.description: Accessible name of the language offer on Home.

offer.available.description: The English half of the offer on Home. {english} is the language's English name.

offer.use.description: The English half of the offer's button.

offer.notNow.description: The English half of the offer's second button.

offer.nextStart.description: The English half of the line shown when Flown cannot restart now.
